title: Easy Storage
text: Easy Storage. I wish all shelves came pre-assembled as this one is.  I have bought 5 of these book cases and all I have to do is take it from the box and open it up and, presto, more storage shelves. The shelves are deep so they can be used for storage or bookshelves.  Great item.

product_metadata.title: Stony Edge Folding Bookshelf, 4-Tier Book Shelf for Books and Trinkets, No Assembly Folding Shelf, Small Bookshelf for Small Spaces in Home and Office, 45 x 16 x 11.5 Inches, Natural Wood Finish
features: Your Innovative Foldable Storage - Experience innovation with our wooden book shelves! Each book shelf offers unrivaled convenience with its sturdy, foldable build. So you can easily store your books and knick-knacks.

Organizes Your Space - Too many books to arrange? This versatile foldable shelf allows you to store and display book collections and ornamental pieces on its spacious shelves. Our folding bookshelf features 4 tiers of spacious storage for more decluttering.

Minimalist, Modern Design - These folding shelves deliver a contemporary touch to any space. Its airy, spindle-side look combines traditional and modern styles, making it a decorative wooden bookshelf that'll fit right into homes, offices, Airbnb rooms, apartments and more.

Stable and Sturdy - Poorly-made wooden bookshelves are easy to break and knock over. Not Stony-Edge’s folding bookcase! It’s made with top-grade wood, with each shelf capable of holding up to 150 pounds. This small book shelf may be lightweight, but it’s never wobbly.

Effortless Assembly - Our foldable bookshelf doesn’t need assembling. Simply fold out the sides and flip down the shelves. We pack each collapsible shelf safely and securely, so you can skip the trouble of repairing damages.
description: Low Assembly Folding Bookshelf. Goodbye Clutter, Hello Innovation. Are you tired of presenting your favorite books on a bookcase that's immobile, clunky, or plain? Each time someone walks into your home, they learn a little more about you. And more than anything, your bookcase showcases your knowledge, personality and individuality. Stony-Edge is here to help you take care of your books with a beautiful high-quality bookcase that's easy to manage, looks great and can be placed almost anywhere! Stony-Edge folding bookcase displays your books and photos with pride. The Stony-Edge folding bookcase adds extra shelving in an instant with four tall shelves that provide plenty of space for books, photos, decor, or your favorite trinkets. With its airy, spindle-side design, this smart wood bookcase will look right at home in any room. The 4-Tier folding bookshelf arrives one easy step from fully assembled—screw a few screws, unfold it, flip it and it's ready to go! Add style to your room now! Stony-Edge's contemporary styled folding bookshelf bridges the gap between traditional and modern. With a minimalist construction, this bookcase lets you easily see what books you have available, gives you a decorative piece to add to any room and can be moved around to suit your layout. There is no limit to what you can do with this folding wooden bookcase. This 4-Tier piece is ideal for storage or as a decorative element in the home. Both sturdy and foldable, the Stony-Edge folding bookcase is truly versatile. Ideal for Apartments, Home and the College Dorm Need some instant vertical space? Want a place for your leather-bound collection of Tom Clancy novels? This is the shortest and sweetest assembly story ever told. Once again, Stony-Edge steps up with another smart, simple and easy solution—the amazing folding bookcase/media center. Books are displayed beautifully and won’t tumble out the backside. Heavier books are no problem with four shelves each capable of holding 150 pounds of weighty literature or equipment ready to fill in minutes. One screwdriver, next-to-no time and absolutely no tantrums. Assemble instantly, grab a book and start reading.
